Senior Lead Software Engineer — AI/ML Training Infrastructure

Location: Hybrid, Seattle, WA

Level: Senior

Requirements

  • 5+ years applied experience with formal training or certification in software engineering
  • Hands-on scalable/HA infrastructure for ML training and/or inference
  • GPU infrastructure, accelerators, high-speed interconnects
  • Kubernetes and containers including Docker (cluster ops, scheduling, observability)
  • Proficiency in Python, Go, Java, or C#

Preferred

  • Performance monitoring/profiling
  • NVIDIA DCGM, BCM, drivers, CUDA
  • MLflow or similar model lifecycle management
  • Distributed training, Ray.io, Slurm

Responsibilities

  • Design, build, operate secure scalable cloud and GPU infrastructure for AI/ML
  • CI/CD pipelines, IaC, SDLC toolchain
  • Multi-GPU/multi-node training support
  • Technical leadership and mentoring
